Mobile first screen has no visible phone number or call button; it shows only the headline
Out-of-date wayfinding references (Loehmann's, Bally Total Fitness) and a 2025 copyright
A guessed /contact URL 404s, and there is a stray emoji in page titles

agent_readiness.notes: HairSalon JSON-LD with name, address and hours is present and hours/services are readable text - better than most in the batch. But booking is phone-only with no form, so an agent must hand off to a human; no scheduler or booking platform of any kind.

operations_signals.signal: Closed Mondays and phone-only booking, so weekend/Monday demand cannot be captured asynchronously
No contact form anywhere on the site, so every enquiry becomes a phone call during service hours
Instagram is used as the portfolio, suggesting social DMs are an informal second intake channel

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online booking (Booksy/Vagaro/Fresha) with automated reminders so clients do not have to call during service hours
top_opportunities.evidence: 'Call to Book' is the only CTA sitewide; no form or scheduler

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a sticky click-to-call button and a contact form, and fix the header so the number shows on the first mobile screen
top_opportunities.evidence: 390px screenshot shows the headline only, no phone number or button above the fold

top_opportunities.opportunity: Refresh stale content: 2025 copyright, closed-landmark directions, broken /contact URL and emoji-titled pages
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page still names Loehmann's Plaza and Bally Total Fitness; /contact returns 404

scores.reasons: Gap: no online booking or form, weak mobile CTA, stale copy - but good schema (HairSalon JSON-LD). Pay: single boutique salon, smaller budget. Ease: booking platform plus small fixes is fast. Evidence: read home, contact page, the 404 page and screenshots.

caveats: East Brunswick Animal Hospital looks corporate-owned: its registration form is hosted at nva.jotform.com, page assets call nva-api-prd.azure-api.net, the favicon filename begins 'NVA_-_East_Brunswick_Animal_Hospital', and its consent script is scoped to domain=nva. This is an inference from page source (NVA = National Veterinary Associates); the home page still says 'family owned and operated'. Treat it as a group-managed site rather than an independent owner.

Five sites in this batch (ebfootcare.com, cfascenter.com, anaramedspa.com, aroramdspa.com, mynewimagehairsalon.com) carry a stray horse emoji in their page titles and share similar templates - inference: a common local web vendor services them, which may slow fixes or route work back to the incumbent agency.

Google ratings and counts were mostly read from third-party aggregators (Birdeye, BestProsInTown, Vet Lookup, Healthgrades) because Google Maps itself was not opened; treat those numbers as approximate. Complete Foot & Ankle and Liquid Hair Salon have no confirmed Google figure.
data_gaps: No Google Business Profile inspection for any of the 10 businesses - hours, categories, services and photo completeness on the profile itself were not verified, so 'findable' scores rely on site robots.txt and third-party listings.
Liquid Hair Salon (B00325) has no confirmed Google rating or review count; the batch listed it as having no website, but liquidhairsalon.com is live and takes online bookings.
Moxie Salon & Beauty Bar (B00326) was not audited beyond confirming it is a chain, per the brief's exclusion rule.
robots.txt for ellanlaser.com, aroramdspa.com, liquidhairsalon.com and mynewimagehairsalon.com was not fully retrieved, so AI-crawler blocks on those four sites are unconfirmed.
Review mining was light: no systematic read of Google review complaints about wait times, missed calls or scheduling for most businesses.
